subject: Progressive net terms + short-term credit corridor for pilot
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediserv.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ap@mediserv.io
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Progressive net terms request for pilot (PO attached)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the routing options. We're ready to move ahead with the 3-week pilot, but finance has asked for a short payment accommodation while we get the billing pipeline in place.

Request: can Redwood accept Net60 for the first two invoices and a temporary credit corridor of up to $75k against invoice exposure for the pilot period? We'll provide a PO today and expedited VAT registration certs for our EU entity (attached).

What we can commit to:
- Signed PO (attached)
- Single-point AP contact: ap@mediserv.io
- DAC to provide bank remittance within 45 days after pilot close

We understand this is not standard. If there's a playbook you use (temporary netterm + deposit, or milestone-based invoicing), let me know and we can adapt quickly.

Claire
Claire Nguyen
Head of Finance Operations | Mediserv Health Solutions
Attachment: PO_6789.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: mediserv_vat_cert.pdf (application/pdf)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediserv.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Progressive net terms request for pilot (PO attached)

Hi Claire — thanks for the PO, and glad the demo went well. Looping in Marissa (CS lead) and Vanessa (Finance) to confirm options.

Initial thoughts: we typically offer Net30 for pilots with an optional short-term credit buffer if a deposit isn't possible. For EU entities we need VAT evidence and an AP contact (you provided both). To make Net60 acceptable for the first two invoices we have two common approaches:

Option A — Deposit + Net30: 25% refundable deposit on kickoff, remainder Net30 after invoice. Deposit reduces exposure and keeps standard terms.

Option B — Temporary Net60 + Credit Corridor: Redwood agrees to Net60 for first two invoices with an internal credit cap (we set $75k in your case) and a contingency clause — if invoices exceed the corridor we'll switch to Net30 + deposit for remaining term.

Operational asks from our side to proceed with Option B (what you requested):
- Signed PO (received)
- Completed vendor credit form + bank details (see link below)
- VAT certificate for the EU entity (received)
- HubSpot deal approval from Finance (we'll mark as conditional)

If you confirm Option B I'll have Vanessa draft a short SOW amendment (1 paragraph) outlining the temporary corridor and the review date.

Karthik

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Progressive net terms request for pilot (PO attached)

Adding notes from the CS side — Marissa here. A couple of operational points to make the corridor safe for both sides:

- Billing cadence: We're going to invoice weekly during the pilot (usage snapshot each Friday) so exposure accrues slowly and is visible.
- Threshold checks: Redwood will send a mid-pilot exposure report when cumulative invoiced amount reaches 60% of the $75k corridor. That triggers a quick finance review (48 hours) to either approve continued Net60 or require a deposit.
- VAT handling: Mediserv noted they'll provide the EU VAT cert. Ensure invoices show reverse-charge where appropriate; we need to mark the invoices for EU VAT treatment so you can reclaim correctly.

I'll prepare the usage templates and weekly dashboard invite once the corridor is signed off.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediserv.io>, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Progressive net terms request for pilot (PO attached)

Claire and team — thanks for the quick turnaround on paperwork. Finance is willing to approve Option B (Temporary Net60 + $75k corridor) with the following binding conditions:

1) Agreement amendment: 1-paragraph SOW addendum signed by Mediserv signatory and Redwood (DocuSign link below).
2) Vendor onboarding form completed (link in this email).
3) If cumulative invoiced amount exceeds $75k before pilot end, Redwood invoices become Net30 and a 25% deposit is due within 7 business days of the notice.
4) Weekly invoicing cadence as Marissa proposed; exposure reports sent to ap@mediserv.io and to priyom.das@redwood.com.
5) Redwood will flag EU invoices with reverse-charge and attach VAT cert; Mediserv is responsible for local VAT reporting.

Attachments required: signed amendment, completed vendor form, bank remittance details. We'll hold the pilot kickoff until DocuSign is counter-signed (we can still provision infra for a soft start).

DocuSign (amendment): https://docusign.com/r/ABCD-Redwood-Mediserv
Vendor form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/forms/vendor-onboarding

Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediserv.io>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Progressive net terms request for pilot (PO attached)

Thanks Vanessa — that's all reasonable. I've uploaded the signed PO and the scanned EU VAT certificate to the Google folder and completed the brief vendor form (link in your email). Signing the amendment now; expect countersignature before EOD tomorrow.

One operational question: can we get the first week's invoice scheduled as "preview" PDF on Friday so we can reconcile usage with our internal chargeback before the Net60 clock starts? If so, that helps us forecast whether we'll hit the corridor.

Claire
Claire Nguyen
Head of Finance Operations | Mediserv Health Solutions
